description: Create or edit the workspace's link-in-bio page at /@slug: its address, title, short bio, photo, its whole look, and whether it's live. The first call sets it up offline from the workspace's first connected account: its name, bio (Instagram), photo and icons (filled_from_account); it shows links with on_bio in links_list order (kind header links are section titles). For the look, start from a preset, then change only what you need in design: fields you leave out stay as they are. Every call returns preview_url, a private link to show the person before the page goes live; with preview, the change isn't saved and the link shows it. Read warnings in the result and fix any before publishing; they mean text that's hard to read. Undo puts the page back.

avatar_url.description: A photo at a public https address; design.header.avatar_media_id (from media_list) wins over it

background.description: gradient runs from colors.background to color2 at angle degrees; image shows image_media_id, darkened by dim percent; pattern repeats a small drawing in pattern_color (null: a faint shade of colors.text); dense ones (checks, gingham, terrazzo, carbon) fade a picked color so words stay readable; tile repeats a picture, sticker or emoji behind the page; a photo background shows no tile

image_media_id.description: A ready photo from media_list; null removes it

tile.description: Only the fields you send change; the others stay

kind.description: image repeats media_id, sticker repeats sticker_id, emoji repeats emoji; a kind without its value shows nothing

layout.description: brick offsets every other one by half a step

media_id.description: A ready photo from media_list; null removes it

opacity.description: Percent. 16 is faint; above 30 words get hard to read

branding.description: The "Made with Chockstone Labs" line. Creator, Studio and managed plans can turn it off; on Starter false is ignored (branding_locked)

buttons.description: glass suits a gradient or photo background; shadow is a hard offset outline

colors.description: muted is the bio line and section titles; accent rings the photo and fills code buttons

escape_in_app.description: On by default. Links opened inside Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Threads or Messenger show an "Open in your browser" button; off, every link is a plain redirect. Store links (Amazon) also try the store's app

follow_brand.description: Wear the workspace's brand kit (brand_kit_get): its colors, fonts, logo, buttons and background show on each view, so a kit change shows at once. Changing one of those here turns it off, unless the kit locks that field

fonts.description: heading is the title and section titles; body is everything else

header.description: avatar_media_id, cover_media_id and logo_media_id are ready photos from media_list; null removes one. classic: photo then title; hero: cover_media_id fills the top of the page under the title, in place of the photo; logo: logo_media_id in place of the photo (show_title false hides the title)

title_size.description: How big the name shows; huge suits a display font like anton

links.description: pictures false lists links by name only, for a shorter page; a featured link keeps its picture, and so do products on a post's sheet. style rows keeps links compact; cards gives a link with a code a roomier card with a larger picture

pixels.description: Ad tracking pixels for visitors who agree to them

enabled.description: Off by default. On with an id: the page asks "This page uses ad tracking. OK / No thanks" and loads the pixel only after OK; with it off the page loads no third-party script

ga_measurement_id.description: Google Analytics 4 measurement id (G-…); null or empty removes it

meta_pixel_id.description: Meta (Facebook) pixel id, digits; null or empty removes it

shop.description: Shop the post: a grid of published posts with products attached (post_links_set), above or below the links; off hides it

disclosure.description: "Products may contain affiliate links." over the shop when any product is an affiliate link

layout.description: tabs: a Links | Shop switch under the bio; the Shop side holds the posts, collections and a searchable My products grid

socials.description: Icons for the connected accounts, plus extra ones; arrays replace what's there

url.description: Profile link, or an address for email and a number for phone

hidden.description: account_ids from socials to leave off

style.description: solid fills each network's mark; line draws it in a thin outline

The page's layout: classic (photo, name, buttons), marquee (full-width cover, large name), index (ruled list), folio (portrait card), gallery (tight photo grid), strip (sideways reel of posts), sticker (flower-cut photo, tilted cards), scrapbook (taped snapshot on graph paper), collage (overlapping tilted pictures), zine (cut-out name strips), pro (banded header, one big button), garage (carbon plates, hazard stripe, numbered rows). Also sets that style's colors, fonts and buttons; send colors or fonts in the same call to keep your own

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

preset.description: A ready-made look: colors, fonts, buttons and background. Photos, layout and socials stay. Applied before design. Suggest aurora, mint, poster, bubble, mono, midnight, lilac, ocean, sage, sunset, citrus, terminal; the others stay only for pages already on them

preview.description: Don't save: preview_url shows the page with this change, for the person to check first. Leave out published and slug. Needs a page: the first save sets one up offline

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: bio_page_update
title: Set up the bio page
